excerpts: Lumilens is the connectivity platform for AI infrastructure, delivering scale-up and scale-out optical interconnect solutions designed for the performance, power, and bandwidth demands of next-generation AI workloads. The company designs, develops, and manufactures near-package optics (NPO), co-packaged optics (CPO), and pluggable optical transceivers for hyperscaler AI data centers. Built on Lumilens' own silicon photonics, mixed-signal ICs, electrical-optical interposers, and optical systems, the LumiCore platform enables tighter integration, higher bandwidth density, lower power consumption, and greater flexibility across AI network architectures.

citations.title: Lumilens emerges with $900M+ in Funding
excerpts: SAN JOSE, Calif. — August 6, 2026 — [Lumilens](https://lumilens.com/) , the connectivity platform for AI infrastructure, today emerged from stealth, having been founded to solve the growing networking bottlenecks limiting AI scale. In just two years after its founding, the company is commercially shipping its first product into production AI data centers under a multi-billion-dollar customer agreement, and announced more than $700 million in new funding co-led by [Atreides Management](https://atreidesmgmt.com/) , [Bain Capital Ventures](https://baincapitalventures.com/) , [Meritech](https://www.meritechcapital.com/) , [Seligman Ventures](https://www.seligman.com/) and [Spark Capital](https://www.sparkcapital.com/) , with participation from [Addition](https://www.addition.com/) , [AICONIC VENTURES](https://aiconicventures.com/) , [Alkeon](https://www.alkeoncapital.com/) , [Harbourvest](https://www.harbourvest.com/us/en) , [J.P. Morgan Private Capital](https://am.jpmorgan.com/us/en/asset-management/mod/growth-equity-partners/) , [Mayfield](https://www.mayfield.com/) , [MVP Ventures](https://mvp-vc.com/) , [Qualcomm Ventures](https://www.qualcommventures.com/) , [Peak XV,](https://peakxv.com/) [Redpoint Ventures](https://www.redpoint.com/) , [Seifdune](https://seifdune.com/) and other top-tier investors. The financing values the company at $5.51 billion and brings its total capital raised to over $900 million.

This is the reported rounded figure: the company's announcement says “more than $700 million” in new funding, distinct from over $900 million cumulatively raised.
